# University Bike Shop

> Student-run bike shop in Palo Alto, CA selling quality used road, gravel, triathlon/TT and mountain bikes at student-friendly prices. Repairs, tune-ups, $99 bike fits and bike consignment. Appointment only, located in Crescent Park, Palo Alto.

## What is University Bike Shop?

University Bike Shop (universitybikeshop.com) is a bike business run by local high schoolers in Palo Alto, California. The team refurbishes and resells used road, gravel, triathlon/TT and mountain bikes, and its workshop handles repairs, tune-ups and professional bike fits. The shop sponsors local school cycling clubs and runs a 5-day summer bike camp for kids.

## Key Facts

- Type: used bike sales, bike repair and service, bike fits, consignment
- Location: Crescent Park, Palo Alto, CA (appointment only, no walk-in storefront)
- Bike fits: $99, by appointment
- Consignment: sell your bike through the shop for a 10% commission
- Summer camp: 5-day bike camp with its own curriculum
- Team: student-run, including student mechanics and sales leads
